description: Stable typed error registry for Protocol v2 HTTP and Runtime Host canonical errors. Error responses MUST carry schema_version, instance_id and one of these typed codes; the UI maps codes to user-visible behavior and MUST NEVER parse Python tracebacks. The retryable flag and optional retry_after are consumed by clients for bounded retry behavior. Keep entries in sync with errors.schema.json#code enum.

codes.message: The request was malformed or failed schema validation.
The request exceeded a request body, part count or staging quota.
Missing or invalid session token.
The connection is not from the loopback interface.
The referenced job id does not exist or has been purged.
The referenced resource (session, item, pipeline) does not exist.
The job is already terminal and cannot be cancelled.
Only failed or cancelled items can be retried.
The retained input required for retry has expired or is unavailable.
Pinning the model would exceed capacity and block a running task.
The supervisor is draining and rejects new jobs.
The job or item was cancelled.
A GPU/host out-of-memory condition occurred; recovery may shrink the batch.
A transient backend error occurred; retrying may help.
The required backend (Paddle/MinerU/PDF) is unavailable.
An inference adapter returned malformed, missing or mismatched item outcomes.
Protocol major version is incompatible; an update is required.
An unexpected internal error occurred.
The referenced Runtime maintenance operation does not exist or has expired.
The operation id is already bound to a different normalized intent.
The command id is already bound to a different command payload.
The Runtime maintenance operation cannot be cancelled in its current state.
Only failed or cancelled Runtime maintenance operations can be retried.
The Runtime maintenance event cursor predates the retained event window.
A capability required by the Runtime maintenance request is unavailable.
The requested Runtime source identity does not match the verified release binding.
Another Runtime maintenance operation owns the Runtime store lock.
The Runtime maintenance installation or verification failed.
A transient local I/O error interrupted Runtime maintenance.
The install plan is expired, unknown, or its verified baseline changed; preview a new plan before confirming maintenance.
The install plan reports unresolved blockers; resolve them or preview a new plan instead of starting maintenance.
The requested OCR engine id is not a stable OcrEngineId value; the request fails closed without falling back to another engine.
The selected OCR engine cannot run in this runtime; the response detail may list the currently selectable engine ids.
The selected OCR engine requires user preparation of a runtime component before use.
The engine field is only valid for the plain-text OCR pipeline and was rejected instead of being silently ignored.
The selected OCR engine does not support the requested language; the response detail may list the currently selectable engine ids.
A selected download source id is not in the runtime.download-sources.v1 catalog; the request fails closed without falling back to another source.
A selected install component id is not in the runtime.component-selection.v1 catalog; the request fails closed without silently installing a different scope.
The requested recognition mode id is not in the ocr.recognition-modes.v1 catalog.
The selected recognition mode cannot run in the current runtime state.
The selected recognition mode does not support the requested preload, TTL, pinning or release operation.
The legacy execution pipeline does not match the selected recognition mode.
The runtime does not provide the ocr.mineru-config.v1 typed MinerU configuration capability; the request fails closed without falling back to legacy options or the flash tier.
The stored legacy MinerU settings cannot be migrated to an equivalent typed configuration; the user must re-select the tier and options instead of relying on a silent fallback.
The selected MinerU tier cannot run in this runtime; the response detail may list the currently selectable tiers.
The selected MinerU tier requires user preparation of runtime components before use.
